artworks.title: Acis and Galatea
artworks.description: Claude's landscape sets the Sicilian love-story in golden light: Galatea and Acis at ease before Polyphemus' jealousy shatters the idyll. Ovid's narrative — the Nereid who turned her slain beloved into a river — became a favourite theme of seventeenth-century pastoral painting.

music.title: Acis and Galatea
music.description: Handel's Galatea mourns her crushed beloved and turns him into a river — the Nereid as English pastoral's sea-born heroine.

popCulture.title: Acis and Galatea
popCulture.description: Galatea remains the sea-nymph who loved a mortal shepherd — beauty that outlived the boulder Polyphemus threw.
